page.layout: One column of running text, Latin with Greek quotations; a catchword at the foot right. Printed page number at the head. No running head and no marginal notes.

main_text.p: flum[?] est. Tum subdit ex Actione sexta, quae in hanc materiam pronunciarunt Legati Pontificij, & Epistolam Ioannis Papae, in qua se de simili additione excusat, nunquam se eam asserendo approbasse, multominus tum, postmodum anathemati subijcit similia in posterum audentes. Simeon Thessalonicensis Dialogo contra Haereses; Ἐπειδὴ οὖν μὴ τῷ ἑβδόμῳ οἰκουμενικῇ ἡ γέγονε Συνόδῳ, ἀλλ᾽ ἡ ὀγδόη λεγομένη, ἧς καὶ Λατῖνοι μεμνῶνται, ἔτι τὰ σφραγιστικὰ [?] Ταύτης ὑπὸ μέρους τυγχάνοντα ἐμφανῆ ἐν οἷς, καὶ ἐπὶ τῆς κοινοτομίας τῆς Λατίνων ὅτι μαθεῖν ἀκριβέστερον, ὅπως ἡ Συνόδος αὐτῇ ὠδὲ ἐκ τοῦ υἱοῦ τὸ Θεῖον πνεῦμα ἐκπορεύεσθαι τολμῆσαι λέγειν ἀναθέματι ὑποβαλεῖν, πρὶν τὰ τῆς ἱερᾶς συμβόλου ἀμέωτα παντὶ ζόωπ παρέδωκε[?]. Post Septimam itaque Synodum nulla alia Oecumenica coacta est, prae qua dicitur Octava, cuius & apud Latinos mentio est, & Acta ex parte patefecerunt, in quibus & de Latinorum innovatione accuratius addiscitur, & qua ratione Synodus illa, Spiritum sanctum etiam ex Filio procedere audentes asserere anathemati subiecit, sacriq; Symboli omnia inviolate conseruari modis omnibus tradidit. Iosephus Bryennius Oratione octava de Sanctissima Triade. Ἀπὸ τῆς ἐνθέσεως ἑβδόμης Συνόδου πέντε[?], καὶ ἐβδομηκοντα[?] ἐν τῆς βασιλείας τὲ Μακεδόνων[?]. Βασιλεὺς ὢ τῶν[?]

page.notes: Printed page 164, one column, no running head. A small dot stands in the left margin beside the line "qua se de simili", a printer's or scan mark, not text, so it is left out. Doubtful readings: "flum" in the first line, which could also be "filium" (marked [?]); the Greek of the Simeon quotation is only partly legible and has been marked [?] where unsure; the Greek of the Bryennius passage is also doubtful and marked [?]. The catchword "Βα-" stands alone at the foot right. The printed text has been left as it is, including "Oecumenica" and "Spiritum sanctum etiam ex Filio".
